- Child abuse consultations handled, FY2024, 223,691: matches the Children and Families Agency's FY2024 material (2026-01-30).
- Number of suicides among elementary, junior high and high school students, 2025, 538: matches Reference Table 2-15 of the White Paper on Suicide Countermeasures, 2026 edition (Reiwa 8) (the 2025 breakdown in that table is entered as text: record JH-A1).
- Number of serious bullying incidents, ten years from FY2015 to FY2024: matches <Reference 9> of the revised version (2026-01-16) of the Survey on Problem Behavior and School Non-attendance (FY2024 is the revised value, 1,404).
- Figure 2-1-37 (school non-attendance) carries the note "data as at the time of publication on 29 October 2025". The number of non-attendance cases was not covered by the 2026-01-16 revision.
